name: Swole
storyline:
The year is 2037, and the world is in the midst of a devastating pandemic. Cities are under lockdown, and people are forced to live in isolation, locked away in their apartments.

You are one of the unlucky ones, trapped in your small, cramped apartment with no way out. Desperate for some kind of escape, you turn to the internet, spending hours each day scrolling through chatrooms and forums, looking for some kind of distraction.

That's when you come across a chatroom filled with muscular, virtual bodybuilders, all promising to sell you the latest and greatest performance-enhancing pills. And with Christmas coming up, you're desperate to impress your cute cousin who's coming over to visit. So you make the decision to order the pills, hoping they'll help you bulk up and look your best.

But little do you know, the pills are actually a dangerous and illegal concoction, designed to turn people into monstrous, mutated beasts. And as you pop the pills and start to feel their effects, you realize it's too late - you've made a terrible mistake, and now you're stuck in your apartment, turning into a monster with no way out.
